newsitem.title: USA: First Central needs capital to operate.
newsitem.headline: First Central needs capital to operate.

text.p: First Central Financial Corp said Thursday it needs capital investment to remain in operation.

The company said it has developed a plan intended to restructure and strengthen its operations and attract substantial capital investors, but said there is no assurance that it will successfully implement a restructuring plan or attract the necessary capital.
In August, the company said its First Central Insurance Co subsidiary ceased writing new insurance business. Since then the company has faced other challenges with the unit.

In May, it sought to negotiate the sale of common stock and warrants to a group of investors who would have received a controlling interest in the company. First Central planned to use proceeds to recapitalize the subsidiary, but negotiations with the group, Connor Clark Ltd, ended in July.
On Thursday the company reported a second quarter loss of $1.05 a share, compared with a profit of $0.03 in the 1996 quarter.
